_note: 2025 新增债务限额 for issuers the MOF disclosure platform (celma.org.cn) has not yet published, taken from each region's own official budget documents. Same source policy as data/prov-reports: the region's own gov.cn domain only, no aggregator, news site or commercial database. Each entry records the exact URL and the sentence the figures come from, so any reader can check it. build_prov_debt_panel.py merges these and tags the row quota_source='budget-report'; a figure here never overrides one the platform publishes. Amounts are 亿元.

_fields.url: official source URL on the region's own gov.cn domain
_fields.title: document title
_fields.scope: what the figure covers, e.g. excludes 计划单列市
_fields.note: anything a reader needs to interpret it
_fields.verification: direct = the figure was read from the source document fetched from its official URL. indirect = the host refuses connections from outside mainland China and the document could not be opened, so the figure rests on corroboration; the note says what that is. A figure read from the MOF disclosure platform's 预决算公开 channel (celma.org.cn / governbond.org.cn) counts as direct: that platform is this dataset's own primary source, and the tables there are the region's own statutory disclosure filed under its area code.
_fields.stage: cumulative = the full amount allocated to the region so far this year (the figure to use). advance = 提前下达 only, a subset allocated the previous autumn. A year in progress may have only the advance batch published.
_fields.as_of: the date the figure is stated as of; a year in progress can still be topped up.

entries.title: 表1-6 安徽省2026年地方政府债务限额调整情况表
entries.venue: 安徽省财政厅，经省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议（2026-07-24）批准后公开
entries.quote: 二、2026年新增地方政府债务限额 1,933.00；其中：一般债务限额 171.00；专项债务限额 1,762.00。附：提前下达的2026年新增地方政府债务限额 1,158.00；其中：一般债务限额 102.00；专项债务限额 1,056.00。
entries.scope: 本地区 = 本级 + 下级，即全省（安徽无计划单列市）
entries.corroboration: Stock limits tie: 22,701.59 + 1,933.00 = 24,634.59, with 5,102.88+171=5,273.88 and 17,598.71+1,762=19,360.71. The advance batch of 1,158 also appears in 表1-5 published 2026-02-24 (https://www.celma.org.cn/yjsxxgk/68059.jhtml).
entries.note: Anhui's own domains return 403 to requests from outside mainland China, so this comes from the MOF disclosure platform's 预决算公开 channel — the same platform that is this dataset's primary source, carrying Anhui's own statutory table filed under its area code.

_validation: Same-measure check: 新疆生产建设兵团 2025 appears in BOTH sources -- the disclosure platform publishes 新增一般债务限额 80 / 新增专项债务限额 131, and the Xinjiang finance department's 2026 budget report states the identical 80 / 131 for the XPCC. So the quota a region reports to the platform and the quota 财政部下达 in its budget report are the same figure, and the two sources can be used in one series. Second check: 深圳市 2025 appears in both sources too -- the platform publishes 15 / 866, and Guangdong's own budget-adjustment report breaks its 5,686 亿元 into 广东地区 305 / 4,500 and 深圳市 15 / 866. The Shenzhen halves match exactly, so Guangdong is entered here on the Shenzhen-excluded basis the platform uses. Third check: the Hubei and Henan documents have 2024 equivalents stating 372/1,661 and 323/1,907, and the platform publishes exactly those figures for 2024. Three independent confirmations that the two sources carry the same measure.
_carryover_note: Why issuance can exceed quota: 结存限额 (unused ceiling carried over from earlier years) is allocated separately and is NOT part of 新增限额. Guangdong received 644 亿元 of it in 2025 (370 of that issued as new special bonds), and Jiangsu a net 119 亿元 (300 for project construction). Those tranches account for the special-bond overshoot in both provinces: Jiangsu issued 2,785 against a 2,485 quota, and 2,785-2,485 = 300 exactly. Execution above 100% in this series therefore means carried-over headroom was used, not that a quota was breached.

_not_entered.reason: Only the 提前下达 advance batch is published (一般126 + 专项2,364 = 2,490, 山东省2025年预算执行情况与2026年预算草案, 表57, http://czt.shandong.gov.cn/art/2026/2/14/art_10575_10329198.html), and it is stated 含青岛市 — Shandong's own documents say 「财政部核定山东省（含青岛市，下同）」. The platform treats 山东省 and 青岛市 as separate issuers, so entering 2,490 would double-count Qingdao. The 不含青岛 split is not disclosed for 2026. The 2026 adjustment plan was approved on 2026-07-23 (https://www.sdrd.gov.cn/articles/ch00628/202607/a149c09e-e29f-4c62-9512-b64aa73d7e5b.shtml) but the report carrying the figures has not been posted; in 2025 it appeared about four weeks after approval, so it is overdue. Re-check czt.shandong.gov.cn/col/col10575.

Not found on any zj.gov.cn source. A figure of 1,937 亿元 (专项1,752) circulates on finance.sina.com.cn, yicai.com and sohu.com, but this repo does not use non-government sources, so it is recorded here as uncorroborated and is NOT entered. The cumulative figure below is sourced and is the one in use.

Only the 提前下达 advance batch is published: 1,285（一般252、专项1,033）, from 《关于湖北省2025年预算执行情况和2026年预算草案的报告》 (https://www.hppc.gov.cn/upload/hppc/2026/07/02/202607020928421515.pdf) for the total, and 表1-5《湖北省2026年地方政府债务限额提前下达情况表》 (https://www.celma.org.cn/yjsxxgk/68970.jhtml) for the split. Not entered because every other 2026 entry is the cumulative figure and mixing the two would make execution rates incomparable. The 2026 adjustment was approved 2026-09-24, so the statutory 表1-6 is due about 2026-10-14; the 人大财经委 review report of 2026-09-21 gives only cumulative stock limits, not a 新增 figure. Re-check https://www.celma.org.cn/yjsxxgk/ and czt.hubei.gov.cn after mid-October. Note: 25,530.7 - 23,396.69 = 2,134 is an upper bound, not the 新增 quota, because the limit increase also carries any 2026 置换 tranche.

_access_notes.czt.shandong.gov.cn: Reachable over plain http:// only — its HTTPS certificate is for another host, so any fetcher that forces HTTPS fails. Article lists are embedded in the column page inside <script type="text/xml"><datastore>, and PDF links point at an internal IP (172.20.232.124) that must be swapped back to the hostname.
_access_notes.czt.hebei.gov.cn: Returns 403 from outside mainland China; use www.hebei.gov.cn and www.hbrd.gov.cn instead.
_access_notes.czt.henan.gov.cn: Returns 403 from outside mainland China; the same documents are on the provincial file server xcoss.henan.gov.cn.
_access_notes.www.qingdao.gov.cn: Refuses connections from outside mainland China, with no Wayback snapshot.
_access_notes.czt.zj.gov.cn attachments: Served from an OSS bucket that returns 403 to IPv6 clients; use IPv4 (curl -4). Newer columns render their item lists through a JS api-gateway call that does not return a listing to a plain fetch.
_access_notes.www.zjrd.gov.cn: Times out entirely from outside mainland China on both IPv4 and IPv6.
_access_notes.czt.ah.gov.cn and other ah.gov.cn hosts: Return 403 with reason:GeoBL from outside mainland China, including via proxies. Anhui's statutory limit tables are reachable on the MOF platform instead.
